Reusable half mask respirator with P3 filters. Provides protection in workplaces that have high incidences of fine dust, lead, silica, MDF particles, or other forms of industrial pollutants in the air. Lightweight, comfortable to wear design with a low-resistance airflow to make breathing easy. Simple and easy to maintain. Dual mode harness enables users to doff mask without removing head protection. Twin-filter provides even distribution of weight with minimal obstruction to field of vision.
